title: TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote fails at base on this shared host: temp tree ticfac-registry-guard-* left behind
body: Running the full (non-short) internal/cli suite fails at the base commit (verified with my changes stashed) on 'the SIGTERM exit left its temp trees behind: [ticfac-registry-guard-<pid>]'. The test skips under -short, so `make gate` is unaffected, but `make test` on this host fails regardless of any tick's work. Likely the shared-machine-state class learnings already record (7ag: sibling suites write ~/.ticfac/registry mid-gate), i.e. environment, not tree.
